sections.text: The northbound connector to northbound SR-133 (Orange Co) is closed from 2300 hrs each night to 0600 each morning thru 9/12/26 - Due to construction - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route

The southbound connector to eastbound US-50 /in Sacramento/ (Sacramento Co) is closed from 2300 hrs each night to 0600 each morning thru 9/12/26 - Due to construction - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route

Is closed to southbound traffic at Jack Tone Rd /in Ripon/ (San Joaquin Co) - Due to a traffic collision - Motorists are advised to use an alternate route A high wind advisory is in effect from the Stanislaus/San Joaquin Co Line to the San Joaquin/Sacramento Co Line - Travel is not recommended for campers, trailers, or permit loads
